Card Q&A.a: Yes. The effect applies to all of your Digimon that meet the conditions, therefore this effect will also affect Digimon that later enter the battle area as long as they meet the conditions.
Card Q&A.q: After using this card, do level 6 Digimon with the [Machine] trait that are newly played or digivolved in the same turn gain  and  from this card's effect?

Effect: [Main] You may trash 1 card with [Cyborg] or [Machine] in its traits in your hand to have all of your level 6 Digimon with [Machine] in their traits gain ＜Rush＞ (This Digimon can attack the turn it comes into play) and “[On Play] If this Digimon has a digivolution card, ＜Blitz＞. (This Digimon can attack when your opponent has 1 or more memory.)” for the turn.
Security Effect: [Security] You may trash 1 Digimon card with [Cyborg] or [Machine] in its traits in your hand to delete 1 of your opponent’s Digimon whose play cost is less than or equal to the trashed card’s play cost.
